name: web-minimal-loading-text-state
title: Minimal Loading Text State
whatItIs: An almost empty white page with one centered line, 'Hello, Shadcnspace' in black followed by 'Initializing ...' in blue, a rolling-text loading state.
whatItMeans: Extreme restraint makes a moment of waiting feel calm and intentional. The color shift separates the constant from the changing part of the message.
techniques: One line of text as the entire composition, centered with vast negative space
Set the changing word in a single accent color while the rest stays neutral
Use a plain system-like sans at modest size so it reads as UI, not decoration
Animate the changing word by rolling or cycling it in place
Treat a loading screen as a brand moment rather than a spinner

vocabulary.definition: A word that cycles or scrolls vertically in place to show changing content.
Empty area that gives the content room and focus.
One word colored differently to mark it as the dynamic or important piece.
